scope: Current primary papers and official artifacts closest to paraphrase robustness, counterfactual target selectivity, object grounding, language-action alignment, and action-chunk adaptation.
epistemic_rules: Paper-level overlap is positioning evidence, not empirical falsification of a local mechanism.
Absent, incompatible, or unrun code is an artifact/comparator limitation.
Only official paper, project, repository, and model/dataset artifacts are used for scientific claims.
Remote availability is never relabeled as a local run.

host_constraint.policy: one live simulator environment and one resident backbone; serial; no CPU/disk model offload; no swap/pagefile growth caused by experiment

paper.title: X-VLA: Soft-Prompted Transformer as Scalable Cross-Embodiment Vision-Language-Action Model

entries.objective: Behavior cloning/action-chunk prediction with cross-embodiment soft prompts.
entries.architecture: Retained 0.9B X-VLA LIBERO policy; this is the frozen Base, not a novelty comparator.

local_run_status.detail: Source and checkpoint are retained locally. Epoch 7 executed official serial closed loop: 30/30 canonical and 19/30 matched paraphrase discovery episodes.

novelty_collision.detail: Defines the Base whose legal input and action interfaces Epoch 8 must preserve.

paper.title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models

entries.objective: Evaluation-only controlled action/object/compositional paraphrase taxonomy plus PRIDE metric; no policy-training objective.
entries.architecture: Benchmark and evaluator integrations; it changes language only and keeps the simulator task fixed.

local_run_status.detail: Clean local clone at the immutable revision. One 360x360 official Goal environment, reset state, two cameras, and close lifecycle passed under the required serial adaptation.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly occupies benchmark-only paraphrase diagnosis and establishes object lexical variation as a major bottleneck; it does not solve binding.

paper.title: When Vision Overrides Language: Evaluating and Mitigating Counterfactual Failures in VLAs

entries.objective: CAG combines an action-conditioned VLA with a language-unconditioned VA branch; TF drops language in the same model, while VA trains a separate visual prior.
entries.architecture: Dual-branch inference guidance; no target-binding head or architecture modification.

local_run_status.detail: Official serial spatial and OOD environment preflights pass. The release has no X-VLA adapter. The corrected local X-VLA CAG-TF port was action-connected but scored 14/30 canonical and 11/30 paraphrase, so it is not a competent positive Prior.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly occupies language-conditioned minus visual-prior action guidance and counterfactual evaluation. Epoch 8 must not relabel residual guidance or the local incompetent port as a novel/positive method.

paper.title: On Robustness of Vision-Language-Action Model against Multi-Modal Perturbations

inference_inputs: standard VLA inputs; no extra inference model
entries.objective: Consistent actions across semantic-preserving input perturbations plus worst-case flow/action-noise training selected with UCB.
entries.architecture: Training-time robust optimization on pi0 and OpenVLA action predictors.

local_run_status.detail: Official source revision resolved, but no released checkpoint/license identity was found and no local environment was constructed.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly occupies action consistency under meaning-preserving lexical/syntactic variation. It does not impose true target-swap selectivity or explicit target binding.

paper.title: CAST: Counterfactual Labels Improve Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models

entries.objective: Augments robot data with counterfactual language and actions so similar observations support different instruction-conditioned behavior.
entries.architecture: Data-generation method plus CounterfactualVLA policy, primarily evaluated in navigation with a manipulation extension.

local_run_status.detail: Code/data/checkpoint revisions resolve. Reproducing the official generation pipeline requires Gemini/GCP credentials and an atomic policy; it is not credential-free locally.

novelty_collision.detail: Closest precedent to learning different actions for alternative feasible instructions under similar observations. A local candidate must use a materially different causal objective and cannot claim counterfactual label diversity itself.

paper.title: RoVLA: Multi-Consistency Constraints for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models

inference_inputs: standard Gaussian action noise for flow integration
entries.objective: Instructional Consistency uniformly samples paraphrases at the data level and adds no explicit IC loss; EC and OC constrain flow evolution and perturbed observations.
entries.architecture: InternVL3.5 semantic encoder plus 32-layer DiT derived from GR00T-N1.6.

local_run_status.detail: Full source/training/evaluation tree resolves; README recommends eight GPUs, publishes no RoVLA checkpoint, and RoboTwin scripts are not directly executable. It is not compatible with the retained X-VLA path.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly occupies paraphrase-based positive instructional invariance; it does not enforce minimal true intent/target changes to separate bindings.

paper.title: Stable Language Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models

repository.license: Apache-2.0 LICENSE; README incorrectly says MIT

entries.objective: Monte Carlo Syntactic Integration minimizes expected semantic loss over paraphrases; Residual Affordance Steering subtracts the visual-only action prior.
entries.architecture: Training-time language-neighborhood expansion plus inference-time dual-stream residual action steering.

local_run_status.detail: Source and checkpoint resolve. No X-VLA adapter is released. The repository's README/license conflict is preserved rather than silently resolved.

novelty_collision.detail: Occupies dense paraphrase neighborhoods and conditional-minus-affordance action guidance; it does not provide explicit target identities or counterfactual target separation.

paper.title: ProGAL-VLA: Grounded Alignment through Prospective Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models

entries.objective: Grounding Alignment Contrastive InfoNCE aligns symbolic goals with entity nodes; SACA forms a verified goal bottleneck and entropy-based ambiguity signal.
entries.architecture: Hierarchical planner + 3D Grounded State Module + cross-attention verifier + action policy conditioned only on verified goal.

local_run_status.detail: No official repository/checkpoint was linked or found; the paper's project URL returned 404. This is an artifact limitation, not a scientific falsification.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly occupies entity-level contrastive grounding causally conditioning action. A patch/target contrastive bottleneck without stronger distinctions is not novel.

paper.title: GuidedVLA: Specifying Task-Relevant Factors via Plug-and-Play Action Attention Specialization

entries.objective: Specializes object, skill, and depth attention heads; object loss concentrates action-query attention on task-object masks.
entries.architecture: pi0 action decoder with ControlNet-style factor branch and zero-initialized fusion.

local_run_status.detail: Contrary to the stale project-page 'coming soon' label, current official source, checkpoint, and dataset all resolve. No X-VLA adapter exists; the extra depth model and pi0 path were not installed locally.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly occupies training-mask-supervised object attention in the action decoder and zero-init residual fusion. A generic object head or mask-aligned adapter is rejected.

paper.title: Direct Action-Head Injection of A Grounded 3D Point Unlocks Spatial and Task Generalization

training_inputs: oracle segmentation-derived 2D target point in simulation
entries.objective: Lifts one target point to 3D, encodes gripper-relative displacement with a two-layer MLP, and adds it to timestep conditioning.
entries.architecture: Zero-final-layer MLP injecting 3D displacement through DiT AdaLN; no backbone change.

local_run_status.detail: No official source/checkpoint was linked or found. Simulation uses oracle target masks; real deployment uses an additional Qwen3-VL-4B grounder.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly occupies lightweight target-conditioned action-head injection, relative geometry, AdaLN fusion, and Base-exact zero initialization.

paper.title: RoboSemanticBench: Diagnosing Semantic Grounding in Action Prediction for VLA Models

entries.objective: Evaluation benchmark separates ability to grasp a candidate from semantic selection of the correct physical answer target.
entries.architecture: RoboTwin-derived benchmark/data/policy harness; not a mitigation method.

local_run_status.detail: Source and two public dataset revisions resolve. The bimanual RoboTwin stack and checkpoints were not installed; only part of the benchmark data is currently pre-collected.

novelty_collision.detail: Occupies decomposed semantic target selection versus motor grasp success; Epoch 8 cannot claim that decomposition as new.

paper.title: Restoring Linguistic Grounding in VLA Models via Train-Free Attention Recalibration

inference_inputs: attention sink statistics inside the forward pass
entries.objective: Detects sink tokens/imbalanced grounding heads and redistributes attention toward instruction tokens at inference.
entries.architecture: Train-free transformer attention intervention plus 30-task ICBench contradiction benchmark.

local_run_status.detail: Official project explicitly says code coming soon; no executable source/checkpoint was available.

novelty_collision.detail: Occupies train-free language-token attention reweighting and contradiction suppression, not learned target binding.

paper.title: Grounding Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Models Through Explicit Language-Action Alignment

entries.objective: Trains a contrastive language-trajectory grounding model, ranks candidate language-action outputs, then uses offline preference learning.
entries.architecture: Hierarchical VLA with a separate action-conditioned grounding scorer and preference loop.

local_run_status.detail: MIT source resolves, but README contains no setup/reproduction path and no checkpoint is released; not a turnkey comparator.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly reinforces the prohibition on renaming Candidate A's scalar action-energy/ranking formulation; it does not supply explicit scene target binding.

paper.title: Generalizable VLA Finetuning via Representation Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment

entries.objective: Anchors student non-action representations to a frozen VLM and predicts discrete motion direction jointly with continuous actions.
entries.architecture: VLA-Adapter-family action head plus representation distillation and direction-alignment projection.

local_run_status.detail: Current inference/evaluation code and four checkpoints resolve. Training code/loss implementation is explicitly deferred; no X-VLA adapter exists.

novelty_collision.detail: Occupies representation preservation and absolute motion-direction language/action alignment. It does not use equivalence classes, target-swap pairs, or an explicit target mediator.

paper.title: When Does Language Matter? Multilingual Instructions Reveal Step-wise Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models

inference_inputs: retrieved reference representations at language-critical steps
entries.objective: Identifies language-critical steps and selectively aligns representations at inference.
entries.architecture: Step-wise sensitivity diagnostic and temporal inference intervention.

local_run_status.detail: No official repository/checkpoint was linked or found.

novelty_collision.detail: Occupies temporal gating of language influence; a step gate alone is not a distinct Epoch 8 mechanism.

paper.title: STRONG-VLA: Decoupled Robustness Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models under Multimodal Perturbations

entries.objective: Separates perturbation-robustness acquisition from later clean-task realignment.
entries.architecture: Two-stage fine-tuning recipe without a target-specific mediator.

local_run_status.detail: No official code/checkpoint was linked or found.

novelty_collision.detail: Occupies curriculum perturbation training plus canonical realignment; generic paraphrase augmentation/retention cannot be Ours.

paper.title: VLA Grounder: Language-Conditioning Space Optimization for Black-Box VLA Models

entries.objective: Optimizes a scene-conditioned language policy that rewrites human intent into VLA-compatible grounded commands using rollout reward.
entries.architecture: Upstream language-conditioning policy; downstream pi0/OpenVLA remains frozen.

local_run_status.detail: Project page and paper resolve, but no source/checkpoint is linked.

novelty_collision.detail: Directly occupies learned grounded command rewriting. Prompt/canonicalization/RL language-space optimization is not a distinct Epoch 8 contribution.

paper.title: CLAP: Direct VLM-to-VLA Adaptation via Language-Action Grounding

official_artifacts.release_statement: paper says weights will be released

training_inputs: natural-language action descriptions prepended to numeric action sequences
inference_inputs: autoregressive language plan then numeric action tokens
entries.objective: Causally generates a natural-language action description before numeric action tokens to keep action prediction near the VLM language distribution.
entries.architecture: Unmodified VLM backbone converted to an autoregressive VLA through output formatting and single-epoch fine-tuning.

local_run_status.detail: The project page currently exposes no code/weights and the paper promises a future open-weight release.

novelty_collision.detail: Occupies language-plan-before-action causal alignment, but not explicit target binding or paired equivalence/selectivity.

novelty_vetoes: external grounded point injected into an action head
entity-level contrastive verified-goal bottleneck without a material distinction
summary.remaining_testable_boundary: A paired, two-sided causal intervention must jointly preserve action behavior within true semantic equivalence classes and enforce the correct signed/action-structured response under genuine target swaps, using real demonstration supervision and legal inference inputs. It must beat one-sided paraphrase training and cannot reduce to a target head, scalar score, residual guidance, rewriting, or synthetic CAST relabeling.
